milestone: SeLinOS persistent root construction context M0

contract.lifetime: Root simple, VKA and VSpace descriptors have static root-private storage and bootstrap rejects a second initialization.
contract.scope: Existing bootstrap callers continue to receive explicit root pointers. Persistent-context M0 itself adds no construction authority; later root-dispatch work is separately evidenced. Post-bootstrap child construction, allocator accessors and child-cap delivery remain absent.
contract.authority: Only root holds the persistent descriptors; no non-root CSpace receives access to VKA, loader VSpace or the root CNode.

required_markers: SeLinOS M0: seL4 root task started.
SeLinOS M0: capability policy validation passed.
SeLinOS ABI M15: fixed immutable FD F_GETFL mediated without VFS IPC.
SeLinOS TCB resume M2: fresh child spawned suspended for one taskd resume.
SeLinOS taskd TCB resume M2 probe: one transferred child resume passed.
SeLinOS M0: thirty runnable isolated service domains and one suspended child fixture configured.
forbidden_markers: SeLinOS M0: root construction context reinitialization rejected.
SeLinOS M0: unable to start root construction adapter.
SeLinOS root construction M1: child constructed.

not_claimed: runtime child construction, dynamic allocation, capability lease or child start
construction-request handling that invokes allocator, loader or child-control operations
Linux clone, fork, pthread, process exit, wait, signal or futex semantics
executable mapping, W^X, native ELF loading, dpkg or apt
